map.name: Skarn Delve
map.setting: a cave town of miners under a mountain
map.trouble: Trolls are swarming up out of the deep shafts and the Lower Shafts have fallen to them; Mayor Vorlund sends the player down to Chief Engineer Dorvak at Thrum Landing

guard_bark.specifics: Hurk, the guard at the gate of Skarn Delve, who suspects the player of hitting Nib

first.speaker: Hurk
first.text: Hold it right there, stranger! Nib says you hit him with a pick for no reason and his bruises prove it! Let's go. There's a cold and tidy cell waiting for you! Will you come quietly, stranger?

again.speaker: Hurk
again.text:
I would stay out of the Lower Shafts...

unless you want a Troll to chew on you.

bounty_offer.specifics: Paymaster Orrin offers a bounty on Skrit, the king of the Imps raiding the ore carts

offer.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
offer.text:
Hello, young sir. I surmise you have come about the bounty.

There is a generous reward on Skrit the Imp King -- dead or alive. He and his noisy swarm of Imps have been raiding the ore carts for weeks.

Take care, you do not want to get bitten by those spiteful pests.

reminder.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
reminder.text: Still no word on Skrit? The Imps are at the carts again!

completion.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
completion.text:
Ho, there! Nib complained of squeaking down this tunnel, so I came to look.

You have single handedly slain the dreaded Skrit! Very impressive! My profound respect is yours! Skrit's swarm has plagued Skarn Delve for weeks! I'll take it from here. We will all rest easier now that this vile pest is dead!

And here is your reward -- 100 in gold!

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Pellwick the assayer has had the Rod of Seeking stolen by a Troll and sends the player on to Dorvak with it

offer.speaker: Pellwick
offer.text: Ooooh, how can this be? That filthy Troll beat both of my helpers. Will you go after him? Quickly, you must stop him before the Rod of Seeking is lost.

refusal.speaker: Pellwick
refusal.text: Oh dear. Then come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Pellwick
reminder.text: Please, I implore you. Catch that cowardly Troll and bring back the Rod of Seeking.

completion.speaker: Pellwick
completion.text: The Rod of Seeking is saved! Dorvak will need my Sounding Bell to read the new seams. Here, carry them both down to him.

after.speaker: Pellwick
after.text: You may have saved the whole Delve with this. Well done, lad! Now, hurry down to Dorvak.

journal.text: Recover the Rod of Seeking stolen by the Troll.

journal_done.text: Take the Rod of Seeking and the Sounding Bell to Dorvak.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: a tip about Mobb and the Lift Key, a tease, and a word about the Trolls

rumour1.speaker: Tarn
rumour1.text: You can find Mobb the Tallyman in the Counting House. He has the Lift Key.

rumour2.speaker: Ysolt
rumour2.text: Duck, stranger, duck! Hee, hee, hee...!

rumour3.speaker: Garn
rumour3.text: We have held the Counting House! Now we must drive the Trolls out of all of Skarn Delve!

shop_greeting.specifics: The inn, arms shop and magic shop of Skarn Delve

inn.speaker: Dugga
inn.text: Thirsty folk are always welcome here. What can I pour for you?

arms.speaker: Kragg
arms.text: It's awful quiet today, with the Troll scare and all.

two_givers.specifics: Master Gruntle sells a blasting lesson for gold, and the odd Wick wants a lever pulled at his signal

offer_a.speaker: Master Gruntle
offer_a.text: Are you ready for your Blasting lesson? That will be 100 gold for the powder and fuses.

offer_b.speaker: Wick
offer_b.text:
Hello, stranger. Could you pull that long lever by the door when I wave my lamp? That would help me a great deal.

Wait until I'm in place first.

outcome_a.speaker: Master Gruntle
outcome_a.text: Hmmm, a pity. Blasting isn't for everyone.

outcome_b.speaker: Wick
outcome_b.text: It worked! I was sure the cart would stay stuck! Thank you! You must be lucky!

journal_a.text: Pay Master Gruntle 100 gold for a blasting lesson.

journal_b.text: Pull Wick's lever when he waves his lamp.

rescue.specifics: Bessa begs the player to rescue her brother Tam, carried off by Trolls into the Lower Shafts

plea.speaker: Bessa
plea.text:
Sir! Help me please! A pack of foul Trolls just broke into the Lower Shafts, the diggings below us, and carried off almost all of the crew! One of them is my dear brother, Tam!

Please rescue him and I promise you a reward!

reminder.speaker: Bessa
reminder.text: Oh why haven't you gone? My brother is in terrible danger!

found.speaker: Tam
found.text:
Hail, brave Adventurer! We are innocent diggers, hauled off from our shaft during a ruthless Troll attack!

Will you please lead us up to the surface? If you do, you will surely have a handsome reward, because the ore carts cannot roll without us!

following.speaker: Tam
following.text: Hurry, kind sir and get us out of these tunnels!

completion.speaker: Bessa
completion.text: Thanks so much, kind stranger! Please take these as tokens of my appreciation!

journal.text: Rescue Bessa's brother from the Trolls in the Lower Shafts.

main_opening.specifics: Mayor Vorlund sends the player down to Chief Engineer Dorvak at Thrum Landing over the Trolls in the deep shafts

herald.speaker: Garn
herald.text: Hello, friend. Mayor Vorlund is expecting you.

opening.speaker: Mayor Vorlund
opening.text:
Something is badly wrong under our mountain. I need you to go down to Thrum Landing. There you must seek Chief Engineer Dorvak.

He has requested our help in dealing with the recent swarming of Trolls in the deep shafts.

Take this lamp -- and gold. Visit the shop if you need more supplies. Then make haste.

The lift beyond the Counting House will take you to Thrum Landing.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Vorlund
reminder.text: I've nothing more to say to you, lad. Go now and help Chief Engineer Dorvak!

journal.text: Leave Skarn Delve and travel down to Thrum Landing.
